item.title: Bond Investors Wary After Warsh Speech Fuels Rate-Hike Bets
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: “There is a risk the market continues to do the Fed’s job, overprices hikes and the Fed doesn’t deliver, as the data comes in muted,” said George Catrambone, head of fixed income at DWS Americas. “It’s less about the fact we’ve been above the 2% target and more about what direction the economy is headed.”
